cue: When the Examen is done, before the Great Silence.
displaces: The first 25 minutes of declared leisure.
first_session: Unpack it, tune it, play one scale badly for 25 minutes. Stop on time.
note: Was drafted into the evening anchor as a competing response to the drinking slot [MARLATT-1985], then pulled. If the drink ration is holding by the time this promotes, that argument is spent and this is just a thing you want to do — which is a better reason anyway.
